text: 南向资金今日净买入24.15亿元。港股通（沪）方面，阿里巴巴-W、腾讯控股分别获净买入5.91亿港元、5.22亿港元；小米集团-W净卖出额居首，金额为7.98亿港元；港股通（深）方面，美团-W、腾讯控股分别获净买入2.71亿港元、2.38亿港元；中芯国际净卖出额居首，金额为4.69亿港元。
text_en: Southbound funds recorded a net purchase of 2.415 billion yuan today. On the Stock Connect (Shanghai) side, Alibaba-W and Tencent Holdings received net purchases of HK$591 million and HK$522 million respectively; Xiaomi Group-W had the largest net sell amount at HK$798 million. On the Stock Connect (Shenzhen) side, Meituan-W and Tencent Holdings received net purchases of HK$271 million and HK$238 million respectively; SMIC had the largest net sell amount at HK$469 million.
